statement: U.S. Equity and Options Markets Holiday Schedule 2026 (Nasdaq Trader): Closed January 1 (New Years Day, Observed), January 19 (Martin Luther King, Jr. Day), February 16 (President's Day), April 3 (Good Friday), May 25 (Memorial Day), June 19 (Juneteenth Holiday, Observed), July 3 (Independence Day, Observed), September 7 (Labor Day), November 26 (Thanksgiving Day) and December 25 (Christmas Holiday); Early Close 1:00 p.m. on November 27 and December 24. '* Nasdaq will continue to send alerts to notify customers of days when the Market will close early.'

sources.quote: Nasdaq Systems Hours of Operation: The Nasdaq Stock Market, System hours: 4:00 a.m. - 8:00 p.m., Market hours: 9:30 a.m. - 4:00 p.m. All Times Eastern (ET).

notes: Nasdaq Trader publishes the current year only; 2027 is refused (CalendarHorizonError) until Nasdaq posts it. Re-check the page each December.

The holiday page on nasdaq.com is not used: its terms (https://www.nasdaq.com/legal) forbid 'any process, whether automated or manual, to capture data or content from the Service' (config/providers/nasdaq.json).
Regular session only; the 04:00-09:30 and 16:00-20:00 system hours (pre- and post-market) are not modelled, and the paper policy forbids trading outside regular hours.
Settlement days are still counted on the XNYS calendar (config/markets/venues.json); the DTC settlement calendar is not verified.
